comment: As a gastroenterology specialist, I highly value the LeveLuk K8 for its profound negative ORP (-850mV) and active hydrogen molecules. My entire household drinks pH 9.5 daily, and digestive comfort and sustained stamina have shown measurable improvements.

The touchscreen is intuitive and responsive. Our kids love dispensing their own hydration bottles. The pH 11.5 water emulsifies pesticides and produce coatings effortlessly, while the 2.5 pH sanitizes kitchen surfaces without any chemical fumes.

Our family has operated this SD501 for over 8 years. It performs with absolute Japanese build quality and mechanical reliability. Running the periodic E-Cleaner maintenance cycle keeps the titanium electrode plates pristine.
We use emGuarde devices across our consultation rooms and travel bags. Compact, quiet, and holds charge reliably for multi-day conferences.
The Kangen Air 500 runs silently on my studio desk via USB-C. Love the compact cube form factor and clean air circulation in smaller workspaces.

We installed the Super 501 in our clinical sterilization suite to produce hypochlorous acid (2.5 pH) for disinfecting surgical trays and patient pre-rinses. The dual-chamber 12-plate system delivers powerful, uninterrupted volume.
